The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

definitions.short: Bela , the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1106. Bela ' II. בֶּ֫לַע proper name, masculine 1. בֶּלַע Gen 36:32 = 1Chr 1:43 ; בָּ֑לַע Gen 36:33 = 1Chr 1:44 a king of Edom, ׳ב בעור בן (compare בִּלְעָם & Di Gen 36:32 ). 2 בֶּלַע 1st son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 ; Num 26:38 , 40 ; 1Chr 7:6-7 , 8:1 , 3 ( בָּ֑לַע ). 3 בֶּלַע a Reubenite 1Chr 5:8 . III. בֶּ֫לַע proper name, of a location city = צֹעַר q. v. Gen 14:2 , 8 . בִּלְעֲדֵי see below בלה .
